source: 刘晓燕《四级你还在背单词吗》
title: The Bird Hospital on Wild Island
tts_text: Wild Island lies far overseas, two hundred kilometres from the mainland. A federal agency governs the island; the Ministry of the Environment pays for the hospital. The hospital is a broad wooden building with a board by the gate. Every spring volunteers assemble from all over the country and come aboard at the coast. A panel of experts visits twice a year; an administrative staff keeps the records. Dr. Shen, the vet, has worked here thirty years and leads the team. She studied abroad for three years before returning to the island. She has a dry wit and a wise, sane way with frightened visitors. She administers the medicine herself and keeps a lengthy record of every case. The first symptom is usually a wrong turn in flight. At dusk the gulls circle clockwise around the lighthouse before they land. A weak bird is often a symbol of something wrong in the sea itself. The old lighthouse symbolizes the island better than anything else. The staff treat every bird with mercy and feel sympathy for the fishermen whose nets cause the injuries. Their work is not a symphony, but on quiet mornings the birds make something close to one. In warm years the season lengthens by a week or two. A deep breath here is enough to fill your chest with salt. The volunteers are alike in one way: none of them can sit still. Likewise, the birds return to the same nest every year. The state plans to widen the channel next year. A young visitor wrote in the book: "Cold, wet, and the best week of my life." Those words led other students to the island.

sentences_cn: 野生岛远在海外，离大陆两百公里。
一个联邦机构管理这座岛；鸟医院的经费由环境部出。
医院是一栋宽阔的木屋，门口立着一块牌子。
每年春天，全国各地的志愿者聚到一起，在岸边登上渡船。
一个专家组每年来访两次；一名行政人员管着所有记录。
兽医沈医生在这里工作了三十年，是这个团队的头儿。
她曾在国外学习三年，之后才回到岛上。
她说话风趣，面对受惊的来客时既明智又清醒。
她亲手给鸟喂药，还为每一个病例写下冗长的记录。
最初的症状通常是飞行时转错了方向。
黄昏时，海鸥会绕着灯塔顺时针盘旋，然后才落下。
一只虚弱的鸟，往往是大海本身出了问题的标志。
这座老灯塔，比岛上任何东西都更能象征这座岛。
员工们对每一只鸟都心怀仁慈，也真心同情那些渔网伤了鸟的渔民。
他们的工作不是交响乐；但在安静的早晨，鸟叫出来的东西很像一首。
暖年里，这个季节会延长一两个星期。
在这里深吸一口气，胸口就全是咸味。
志愿者们有一点是相同的：谁也没法安安静静坐着。
同样地，这些鸟每年都回到同一个巢。
政府计划明年把航道加宽。
一位年轻访客在门口的册子上写道：“又冷又湿，却是我这辈子最好的一周。”
这些话把更多学生引到了岛上。
